changelog.text: Custom vehicle categories are now supported. Any category name in your vehicle list that isn't a built-in GTA class becomes its own category.
Custom categories can be assigned when creating or editing a dealership.
The showroom catalog now groups vehicles by your own category names instead of GTA class names.
You can type a category when adding or editing a vehicle instead of only picking from the built-in list.
